largestMaterialGap.title: A finalized native RESPONSE failure can re-enter the model on recreated-factory recovery
largestMaterialGap.confidence: HIGH: source plus repeated actual public-path reproductions on fixed candidate bytes

source.detail: TERMINAL_STOPS omits INTERNAL_FAILURE and MODEL_FAILURE. rejectCheckpoint only rejects stops in that set. Native-attempt guard only rejects RESPOND rows strictly ahead of checkpoint state cursor.
Failure reconciliation advances cursor to acknowledged terminal RESPOND row; post-model checkpoint errors can propagate as ordinary errors.

largestMaterialGap.trigger: Complete mode, rules issue CALL_TOOL then RESPOND(responseIntent), actual local model returns known usage, first post-model checkpoint write throws before commit once, later writes become healthy. Recreate public factory with same in-memory step store/journal and run identical input with spare model slots.
largestMaterialGap.expected: Known actual usage is ACKed exactly once when writer becomes healthy; durable refusal prevents any new RESPONSE/effect on recovery. No retrospective fabricated charge for a never-ACKed usage record.
variantsObserved: Transient post-call checkpoint outage with maxModelCalls=5: actual entries 1 -> 2 and COMPLETED.
Same transient outage with empty response: actual entries 1 -> 2.
Terminal step write fails before commit once: native FAILED row recovered, but later factory enters model again.
Terminal step SUCCEEDED write commits but ACK is lost: SUCCEEDED fact retained, but later factory enters model again.
Model throws: MODEL_FAILURE persisted yet recreated factory calls model again.
Response selector throws: first attempt has zero provider entries, later factory calls model and completes.
With maxModelCalls=1 the existing budget blocks actual second entry, but recovery mutates cursor/checkpoint to a new failed step/MAX_MODEL_CALLS instead of refusing the prior durable attempt.
notAFinding: Persistently unavailable post-call checkpoint writer retains one pre-call slot and zero stored tokens/cost, preserves journal/checkpoint and explicitly refuses recovery with uncertainty/reconciliation. This is correct conservative accounting, not missing fabricated settled billing.
A held native model-call slot before a failed ACK is not proof of an actual provider invocation.
Second-call usage in the transient reproduction is backed by two real local synthetic model entries; it is not double-counting one result. The defect is permitting the second entry.
authority: criteria.cases RR14/RR15 and RR17 extension: empty model text has a durable refusal and terminal replay adds no model/effect; empty response plus transient checkpoint outage independently reproduced
criteria.additionalRequired[1]: healthy writer failures require aligned terminal refusal
criteria.durableResponseRequired[0]: no re-invocation after checkpoint outage with shared slots/spares
largestMaterialGap.recommendedDirection: Make completed RESPONSE attempts/failures durably non-replayable in complete mode independently of spare budget, without adding a decision gate/counter/receipt or fabricating usage. No implementation changes made or approved by I1.
